heading: Connections
explainer: External systems Cogeto reads from. A connection only ever reads; every synced page becomes an ordinary source you can inspect, audit and delete.

list.error: We couldn't load your connections just now.
list.removeConfirm:
Remove {{name}}? Its stored credential is destroyed and syncing stops. Everything already ingested remains: the sources and their facts are NOT deleted, and each one can still be deleted individually from the Sources page.

Remove?

pausedReason.rate_limited: Waiting: the upstream rate limit was reached. Syncing resumes on its own.
pausedReason.daily_item_cap: Waiting: the daily item cap is reached. Syncing continues when the cap resets.
pausedReason.daily_upload_limit: Waiting: the daily upload limit is reached. Syncing continues when the limit resets.

connect.name: Name
connect.apiTokenHelp: An Atlassian API token for this account. Cogeto validates it with one read call before storing it, sealed.

readOnly.statement: Cogeto only reads from Confluence. It never creates, edits or deletes anything there.
readOnly.recommendation: For stricter setups we recommend a dedicated Atlassian account with read-only permission on the chosen spaces, so Confluence itself enforces the restriction.

connect.success_one: Connected. This account can see {{count}} spaces. Open the connection to choose what to sync.
connect.success_many: Connected. This account can see {{count}} spaces. Open the connection to choose what to sync.
connect.success_other: Connected. This account can see {{count}} spaces. Open the connection to choose what to sync.

failure.wrong_site: The address answered, but it is not a Confluence Cloud site. Check the site URL.
failure.bad_credentials: Confluence did not accept this email and API token pair.
failure.no_permission: The credentials work, but this account cannot see any spaces.
failure.unreachable: The site could not be reached. Check the address and your network.

detail.title: Connection
detail.error: We couldn't load this connection just now.

reconnect.explainer: The stored credential no longer works. Enter the site URL, the account email and a fresh API token; the new credential replaces the old one.

spaces.heading: Spaces
spaces.explainer: Nothing outside the spaces you select is ever fetched. Attachments are off by default because they multiply volume.
spaces.empty: No spaces discovered yet. Run a sync to refresh the list.
spaces.attachments: Pull attached files from this space's pages (PDF, Word, spreadsheets, images)

subtree.heading: Add a page subtree
subtree.explainer: Sync one page and everything under it. The page id is the number in the page's URL.
subtree.label: Label
subtree.added: Added. It is fetched on the next sync.

backfill.heading: Backfill and caps
backfill.explainer: How far back the first sync of a scope reaches. The default is 30 days and 500 items per space.
backfill.everythingHelp: No date or item bound. Every page of every selected space is fetched.

presence.explainer: Compares the record against what Confluence still lists and marks pages that disappeared or were archived. A sync never deletes anything.

erased.title: Deleted by you
erased.explainer: Sources you deleted stay deleted: a sync never brings them back on its own. Ingesting one again is your explicit choice, and it returns as a brand-new source.
erased.confirm: Your original deletion stays deleted. The next sync will bring this item back as a brand-new source with fresh extraction. Continue?
